findings.title: Second donor-content hash is no longer bounded to the sized artifact
findings.specific_location: copy_fixed lines534-535 calls digest(source); digest lines170-174 reads until EOF.
findings.required_by: Retained ordinary-output-capture-design-review.json RECOVERY-COPY-001 explicitly preserved bounded copy and bounded second hash plus one extra-byte growth probe; old source_digest_fixed/bounded_chunks implements that bound.
findings.concrete_behavior: The first file_state(source)==expected check in the final condition can pass, then the source can grow during digest(source). That second pass reads beyond expected[2] before any later identity rejection and can continue indefinitely if growth continues. digest also has no cancellation poll. This is a static interleaving permitted by this code, not an observed workspace event.
findings.impact: Reintroduces the previously corrected unbounded donor validation pass and can retain the capsule locks in a non-child read despite a cancellation request. It does not establish false proof acceptance or incorrect archive publication: a completed changed read is rejected.
findings.requested_correction: Restore a source-only fixed-length hash: require opened identity, read at most the sized byte count with cancellation checks, perform exactly one extra-byte growth check, and recheck open/path identities. Keep source/destination failure distinctions and all stock commands, pins, ceilings and gate requirements unchanged.
findings.verification_performed: Static comparison of the complete new source with old bounded_chunks/source_digest_fixed and retained RECOVERY-COPY-001 only. No test, growth probe or execution.

findings.title: Archive manifest omits the required capture interval
findings.specific_location: Capture.record has started_at at lines351-355, but manifest lines699-708 only includes captured_at and a relative receipt path.
findings.required_by: Current-kit-ordinary-capsule-preparation-045.json contents explicitly requires capture interval in the manifest. The old manifest preserved each candidate started_at/ended_at.
findings.concrete_behavior: The published archive manifest cannot identify capture start or a named end of artifact capture from its own fields. Per-batch hash start/end timestamps omit earlier private copying, and receipt is only an external path reference.
findings.impact: Missing declared recovery provenance in an otherwise transport-verifiable archive; no claim that this weakens the kernel or the actual validation gates.
findings.requested_correction: Include truthfully named interval endpoints in the manifest before serializing it, for example capture start and artifact-capture completion. Do not label that pre-transport endpoint as final driver/transport completion.
findings.verification_performed: Static comparison of complete new manifest construction and preparation/old-capture records only.
